title: Teaching English to North Korean Refugees in South Korea: An Interview with Karen Choi
summary: This interview with Karen Choi, an instructor of teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) at Hanyang University in Seoul, South Korea, addresses problems of teaching English as a foreign language (EFL) to North Korean refugees in South Korea.
